pkgmetadata.longdescription: OpenAI Codex CLI is a terminal-based coding agent that can inspect projects, propose and edit code, and execute commands subject to configured approval and sandbox policies. This package installs upstream prebuilt Linux binaries and companion executables. Thus, codex CLI is a tool designed to supportTerminal Workflow: Piping output, generating code blocks from strings, running automated workspace scans, etc. It is a light, text-only client alternative to running codex in VS Code, or to running a full Desktop App. Note that desktop widgets for purposes such as usage monitoring exist separately
